parameters.threshold: change rate within 2x the layer-matched control's, applied at interpretation; every k reported
parameters.upstream_control: recall@25 at readout layers with no ablated head at or below them must equal the measured reproducibility floor (exact equality when the unablated readout reproduces bit-identically); hard fail
parameters.selection: J label preservation beyond every one of 20 rotated-J draws and 20 MLP-row draws, and at least double their medians; layer 32 excluded; gain reported beside; ordered by preservation margin
